title: Storage stability of lipid nanoparticles: a curated benchmark dataset, systematic threshold analysis, and per-study machine learning prediction limits
why_matters: 唯一一篇明确报告预测失败并给出具体数字的论文：613配方/18研究，分组CV后中位R2=-1.53，0/12达到R2>=0.70，跨研究R2 -1.73到-0.27；结论是瓶颈在报告标准化不在模型

title: Artificial Intelligence in the Design and Development of Nanoparticle Drug Delivery Systems: A Systematic Review
journal: Advances in Pharmacological and Pharmaceutical Sciences
why_matters: 17篇AI纳米递送研究中只有4篇做了独立外部验证，9篇有实验验证；PROSPERO 1148160，用TRIPOD-AI+JBI评估。这是评审意见说缺独立验证的直接文献依据

title: Dynamic Light Scattering Method Using Derived Count Rate to Accurately Quantify Lipid Nanoparticle Concentration - A Double-Blind Study
why_matters: 全库唯一明确的双盲验证设计：独立配制批次+随机组成+浓度未知+不同经验水平配方师，预测误差约4%，且结果与操作者经验无关。验证方案设计可直接照搬

title: Computer-aided design of liposomal drugs: in silico prediction and experimental validation of drug candidates for liposomal remote loading
why_matters: 前瞻性验证范本：QSPR虚拟筛选药物库后选3个化合物实测，另用文献中10个未参与建模的分子做外部验证集，外部准确率82%或92%（按模型）

title: Machine learning-driven optimization of mRNA-lipid nanoparticle vaccine quality with XGBoost/Bayesian method and ensemble model approaches
why_matters: 给出可直接用作接受标准的误差量级：n=24 I-optimal设计，实测粒径94-96nm对预测95-97nm，即约1-2nm偏差；SVEM总体预测>97%，XGBoost/Bayesian>94%

title: Comparative study of lipid nanoparticle-based mRNA vaccine bioprocess with machine learning and combinatorial artificial neural network-design of experiment approach
why_matters: 明确写出配方接受窗口：粒径40-100nm、PDI<=0.30、ZP>=±0.30mV、EE>=70%；ANN R2=0.7269-0.9946，四个指标的RASE改善幅度分别列出

title: High-throughput microfluidics and machine learning-assisted screening of lipid nanoparticle formulations for siRNA delivery
why_matters: 最接近前瞻性设计的流程：864配方库先测203个空LNP，模型预测全库粒径PDI后锁定25个做siRNA载药和生物验证；关键结论是理化性质达标不足以保证生物性能。之前session因PMC验证码没拿到全文

title: Accelerating ionizable lipid discovery for mRNA delivery using machine learning and combinatorial chemistry
why_matters: 前瞻性验证样本量明确：584脂质训练，虚拟筛选40000个，合成并实测排名最高的16个，命中lipid 119-23。n=16是这类研究的典型前瞻验证规模

title: Artificial intelligence-guided design of lipid nanoparticles for pulmonary gene therapy
why_matters: LION方法：>9000条LNP活性数据训练，in silico评估160万脂质，选出FO-32/FO-35并在小鼠和雪貂两个物种验证。跨物种验证是说服力最强的一类

title: Designing lipid nanoparticles using a transformer-based neural network
why_matters: COMET/LANCE，公开声称是最大LNP数据集之一，有体内外实验验证且能外推到训练集外细胞系。需全文确认LANCE规模、是否可下载、验证配方数

title: Machine-Learning Framework to Predict the Performance of Lipid Nanoparticles for Nucleic Acid Delivery
why_matters: 6454个LNP配方汇总自21项独立研究，scaffold-based 5折CV下分类准确率>90%，迁移学习做体外到体内>82%。汇总表若可提取是C工作流的大增量

title: Liposomal Nanovesicles for Efficient Encapsulation of Staphylococcal Antibiotics
why_matters: 包封率测定方法本身的偏差量级：万古霉素低估至多24%或高估至多57.9%，利福平低估至多61.1%。这个数字决定模型误差的下限，也是接受标准不能定太严的理由

title: A careful look at lipid nanoparticle characterization: analysis of benchmark formulations for encapsulation of RNA cargo size gradient
why_matters: 同一批样品按EEinput%算全部<50%，按传统EE%算一致>85%，口径差异超过35个百分点；且粒径与载荷长度无强相关（反直觉）。定义不统一是跨研究不可比的核心证据

title: Physicochemical and biological evaluation of a GMP-grade ionizable lipid for robust and scalable manufacturing of siRNA- and mRNA-loaded lipid nanoparticles
why_matters: 回答批间变异问题的最佳数字：4次独立GMP微流控生产，所有CQA（粒径/PDI/EE/mRNA完整性）相对标准差均低于5%

title: Process Robustness in Lipid Nanoparticle Production: A Comparison of Microfluidic and Turbulent Jet Mixing
why_matters: 三因素三水平全因子设计对比同轴湍流射流与交错鱼骨微流控的过程稳健性，给出了混合器技术对比的方法学路线图。需全文取变异数值

title: Effect of Manufacturing Tolerance of Microfluidic Device on the Physicochemical Properties of Nanoparticles for Nanomedicine Applications
why_matters: 硬件方向的直接论证：Ni-PTFE模具公差（宽+0.60%、深-1.68%）优于镍模具（宽-3.09%、深+3.66%），且混合性能对深度偏差高度敏感，最终影响粒径和PDI

title: Interlaboratory comparison for the measurement of particle size and zeta potential of silica nanoparticles in an aqueous suspension
why_matters: 实验室间粒径重复性的核心数字：38个实验室，10-100nm二氧化硅，实验室均值的标准差3.7%到6.5%（CLS/DLS/EM）。这是模型误差要打败的基准

title: Inter-laboratory comparison of nanoparticle size measurements using dynamic light scattering and differential centrifugal sedimentation
why_matters: 没有SOP时实验室间离散度有多大：40个实验室测19nm二氧化硅，上报结果分布在10nm到50nm；制定SOP后才收敛。支持报告标准化论点

title: Interlaboratory comparison of size and surface charge measurements on nanoparticles prior to biological impact assessment
why_matters: IANH round robin，10实验室：单峰预分散体系DLS可重复，但多分散聚集体不可重复，超声进一步加大变异；Zeta电位变异大到需要重新定协议

title: Development and Validation of Optical Methods for Zeta Potential Determination of Silica and Polystyrene Particles in Aqueous Suspensions
why_matters: Zeta电位实验室内精度的干净数字：ELS与PTA两法均为重复性2%、中间精密度3%、正确度4%

title: An Interlaboratory Comparison on the Characterization of a Sub-micrometer Polydisperse Particle Dispersion
why_matters: 多分散体系的变异上限：20个实验室，变异系数13%到189%；实验室内变异平均只占实验室间变异的37%。说明跨实验室比较必须留出的余量

title: On the Operational Aspects of Measuring Nanoparticle Sizes
why_matters: 跨技术一致性：单峰分布样品各技术间差异在25%以内，多峰分布样品技术间差异可达300%。给粒径标签的可比性设了边界

title: Benchmark of Nanoparticle Tracking Analysis on Measuring Nanoparticle Sizing and Concentration
why_matters: NTA实验室间比对，10个欧洲机构，单分散样品变异系数低于5%，量程30-600nm

title: Particle size distributions by transmission electron microscopy: an interlaboratory comparison case study
why_matters: TEM实验室间比对，8个实验室测NIST RM8012（标称30nm金），实验室间均值27.6±2.4nm，对数正态拟合最优

title: Post hoc interlaboratory comparison of single particle ICP-MS size measurements of NIST gold nanoparticle reference materials
why_matters: spICP-MS六实验室比对：实验室间变异显著，同一实验室内不同操作者间变异更小。区分了操作者误差与实验室误差

title: Measuring Encapsulation Efficiency in Cell-Mimicking Giant Unilamellar Vesicles
why_matters: 单颗粒层面包封率离散度：平均11.4±6.8%，但逐囊泡从2.4%到41%。提醒批平均EE掩盖了颗粒间巨大差异

title: Methodological advances in liposomal encapsulation efficiency determination: systematic review and analysis
why_matters: 包封率测定方法系统综述（透析/超滤离心/差速离心/SEC）的适用范围与局限，是给自己定EE测定SOP的起点。需全文取各法精度数值

title: How to determine entrapment efficiency in lipid and polymeric nanoparticles: a methodological guide
why_matters: 包封率方法选择决策树，明确强调方法验证和标准化协议缺失。可直接作为自建SOP的模板

title: Predicting liposome formulations by the integrated machine learning and molecular modeling approaches
why_matters: 给出具体分子特征窗口：logS在-3到-6、分子复杂度500-1000、XLogP3>=2的药物包封率更高；并用粗粒化MD解释NAP进双层而PAL留水相。B工作流的锚点论文

title: Encapsulation efficiency of water-soluble and insoluble drugs in liposomes prepared by the microencapsulation vesicle method
why_matters: 直接比较分配系数口径：包封率与logP(辛醇/水)强相关，也与logP(氯仿/水)相关，作者判定辛醇水logP是更好的指标。这正面回答B3问题

title: Bridging membrane fluidity studies with a predictive model of drug encapsulation to address industrial challenges of liposomal injectables manufacturing
why_matters: 把膜流动性做成可量化上游变量：阿霉素(logP 1.5)需流动性阈值4.41达到>=90%载药，柔红霉素(logP 2.32)只需3.85，即logP越高所需流动性越低。机理上游量的少见定量关系

title: A Systematic Approach for Liposome and Lipodisk Preclinical Formulation Development by Microfluidic Technology
why_matters: 按logP分段给出载药规律：高logP(姜黄素)进双层且EE高，中等logP(环孢素A、地塞米松)在PEG含量更高的lipodisk中显著更高，负logP(阿昔洛韦)无论怎么调都低

title: Predicting hydrophilic drug encapsulation inside unilamellar liposomes
why_matters: 亲水药物包封的物理模型（非数据驱动）：用粒径分布、脂质浓度、脂质分子表面积、双层厚度解析计算，并用实验和文献数据验证。是物理模型对照组的代表

title: Advanced analysis of formulation parameters governing encapsulation efficiency: drug delivery system
why_matters: 用因果发现（PC/GES/LiNGAM）而非相关性分析niosome包封率：116个薄膜水化样本，结论是药物亲脂性是上游约束而非可干预杠杆，且预测重要性不等于因果影响

title: Comprehensive Analysis of Liposome Formulation Parameters and their Influence on Encapsulation, Stability and Drug Release in Glibenclamide Liposomes
why_matters: 逐一拆解链长、不饱和度、相变温度Tc、胆固醇含量对EE/粒径/ZP/PDI的影响方向，长链提高载药与保留，高胆固醇降低载药

title: Optimizing Nanoliposomal Formulations: Assessing Factors Affecting Entrapment Efficiency of Curcumin-Loaded Liposomes using Machine Learning
why_matters: LSBoost建模姜黄素脂质体EE，MAE=3.61，给出最优条件（摩尔比55:5:35:5、PDI 0.09-0.13、粒径约130nm、超声30min、pH 7.2-8）

title: Application of ensemble machine learning approach to assess the factors affecting size and polydispersity index of liposomal nanoparticles
why_matters: 同一课题组的粒径/PDI模型，MAE分别1.652和0.0105，两个固定组成体系下系统改变超声时间与温度。固定组成扫描数据，C工作流可抽取

title: Production of liposomes by microfluidics: The impact of post-manufacturing dilution on drug encapsulation and lipid loss
why_matters: 常被忽略的工艺混杂因素：流速比决定残留乙醇量，残留乙醇越高EE越低且纯化时脂质流失越多；残留乙醇降到5%可避免。建模时若不记录纯化方式就会把这部分方差归错

title: TuNa-AI: A Hybrid Kernel Machine To Design Tunable Nanoparticles for Drug Delivery
why_matters: 自动液体处理平台产生1275个配方（药物+辅料+摩尔比），混合核同时建模分子特征与相对组成，并用venetoclax和trametinib两个案例做实验验证。数据集若公开是C工作流高价值目标

title: In silico prediction of siRNA ionizable-lipid nanoparticles in vivo efficacy: Machine learning modeling based on formulation and molecular descriptors
why_matters: 120条数据的小样本QSAR，训练90验证30，两种划分下外部R2分别0.86-0.89与0.75-0.80；限定在适用域内后R2从0.47提升到0.96。适用域这一步值得照搬

title: Predicting tissue distribution and tumor delivery of nanoparticles in mice using machine learning models
why_matters: Nano-Tumor Database做器官分布预测，测试集R2：肿瘤0.41、心0.42、肝0.45、脾0.79、肺0.87、肾0.83。器官间精度差异本身是E工作流的重要先验

title: Review of Machine Learning for Lipid Nanoparticle Formulation and Process Development
why_matters: 明确点出LNP配方研究仍以经验为主的原因，并专章讨论配方科学家与数据科学家之间的数据科学障碍。申请材料里论证数据基础设施必要性的引用源

title: Artificial Intelligence in Nanopharmaceutical Development: From Predictive Design to Clinical Translation
why_matters: 把转化受限原因逐条列出：数据碎片化、报告标准不一致、可解释性不足、外部验证缺失、适用域定义不清、监管预期演变。可直接作为论证清单

title: Machine learning empowered formulation design, optimization and characterization of nanoparticulate drug delivery systems
why_matters: 横跨聚合物NP、LNP、脂质体、SLN、NLC、niosome等体系的ML综述，含各CQA预测现状。查综述汇总表是C工作流的既定路线

title: Artificial Intelligence Predictive Models in Nanoparticle Analysis for Cancer Targeted Therapy: A Systematic Review
why_matters: 用改编PROBAST-AI清单评估偏倚，指出缺失值与离群值处理不当、样本量相对特征数过小造成偏倚风险。偏倚评估工具可借用

title: Industrial Perspective on the Manufacturing of Lipid Nanoparticles for Nucleic Acid Delivery
why_matters: 按规模（µL到L）梳理CPP与CQA对应关系，含TFF下游处理对CQA的影响。定义工艺侧必记元数据字段的参考

title: Transformer-based multidimensional feature fusion for accurate prediction of lipid nanoparticles transfection efficiency
why_matters: LNPs-TE基准数据集超过10000条实测转染效率，代码与数据公开在github.com/U12458/LIFT；回归Pearson 0.845，分类AUC 0.818，含scaffold划分与activity cliff任务

title: Machine Learning Elucidates Design Features of Plasmid DNA Lipid Nanoparticles for Cell Type-Preferential Transfection
why_matters: 六种细胞类型的pDNA LNP转染数据集，预测误差5-10%，并给出可操作组成规则（带电helper脂质占9-50%等）。需全文确认数据是否随文发布

title: Advancing Cellular-Specific Delivery: Machine Learning Insights into Lipid Nanoparticles Design and Cellular Tropism
why_matters: 180个LNP配方的DoE+高通量筛选数据，目标是免疫细胞靶向并减少肝摄取，有体内脾脏表达验证。配方数明确，适合抽取

title: Machine learning-assisted design of immunomodulatory lipid nanoparticles for delivery of mRNA to repolarize hyperactivated microglia
why_matters: 216个LNP配方库，变化脂质组成、N/P比、透明质酸修饰，MLP加权F1>=0.8，并用4个未见配方做验证。小而完整的组合扫描

title: Rational Design of Lipid Nanoparticles for Enhanced mRNA Vaccine Delivery via Machine Learning
why_matters: 213个LNP用314个特征做随机森林，指出苯酚子结构影响包封与表达，碳链长度影响包封率与稳定性

title: Prediction of lipid nanoparticles for mRNA vaccines by the machine learning algorithm
why_matters: 325条mRNA疫苗LNP配方带IgG滴度，lightGBM R2>0.87，动物实验验证了MC3优于SM-102的预测排序。早期代表作，数据规模明确

title: Machine learning-driven exosome-mimetic lipid nanoparticles for tumor-specific targeting
why_matters: 用LipidGAN生成式模型把实验与公开数据扩增到17800条脂质组成。注意：绝大部分是生成数据不是实测，不能当真实数据集用

title: Integrating machine learning and physics-based modeling for predictive design of gemcitabine-loaded nanocomposites
why_matters: 59个实验配方+200个物理信息合成数据点，XGBoost在载药率R2=0.89、包封率R2=0.91。合成数据占比过高，引用时要标明

title: Modeling the Distribution of Diprotic Basic Drugs in Liposomal Systems: Perspectives on Malaria Nanotherapy
why_matters: 从分配系数到包封率最完整的定量链条：逐微物种给出膜溶液分配系数（pH与磷脂组成的函数），反推EE，在75%的pH/脂质组成条件下与实测无显著差异。可离子化小分子体系，与圣草酚处境接近

title: Computational Prodrug Design Methodology for Liposome Formulability Enhancement of Small-Molecule APIs
why_matters: 明确提出脂质体可配方窗口由双层渗透性和水脂分配系数共同决定；COSMOperm计算显示每加2个碳渗透性升约一个数量级；分配只取决于基团大小类型，渗透性还取决于基团位置

title: Dynamic, Nonsink Method for the Simultaneous Determination of Drug Permeability and Binding Coefficients in Liposomes
why_matters: 一次非漏槽释放实验同时得到释放速率常数和双层水分配系数，并给出药物二聚化与双层表面电荷对分配系数的影响。自建分配测定方法的首选方案

title: Liposome transport of hydrophobic drugs: gel phase lipid bilayer permeability and partitioning of the lactone form of a hydrophobic camptothecin DB-67
why_matters: 疏水药物的渗透性数学模型，把实测值与体相溶解扩散模型和屏障域溶解扩散模型的理论估计对比；明确警告透析类释放实验不做方法验证会产生假象

title: Capacities of membrane lipids to accumulate neutral organic chemicals
why_matters: 回答B3偏差幅度的最佳文献：240个中性有机物，log Klipw与log Kow平均差0.4个对数单位；PP-LFER拟合标准差0.28到0.31优于Kow模型；对氢键供体类化合物膜脂比储存脂高2个对数单位；不支持疏水性截止假设

title: Coumarin Partitioning in Model Biological Membranes: Limitations of Log P as a Predictor
why_matters: logP定性失效的最干净反例：三个同系7-氨基香豆素，logP预测C151富集40倍C152富集500倍，实测C151完全留在水相、C151.5停在极性头基区。证明logP排序与实际分配位置可以脱钩

title: Partitioning of moderately hydrophobic endocrine disruptors between water and synthetic membrane vesicles
why_matters: Klipw因膜流动性和胆固醇含量不同可差2个数量级；明确结论Kow单独估计Klipw能力有限，需加摩尔液体体积MLV和极性表面积PSA。直接给出B4的两个补充描述符

title: pH-Dependent Partitioning of Acidic and Basic Drugs into Liposomes - A Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship Analysis
why_matters: 描述符级结论最明确的一篇：18个酸碱药物，分配随极化率增加、随亚结构部分电荷之和减少；中性与阳离子存在氢键受体强度的不利影响；氢键供体效应不影响脂质体分配。后者与通常把HBD/HBA对称放入的习惯相反

title: pH-Metric logP 10. Determination of Liposomal Membrane-Water Partition Coefficients of Ionizable Drugs
why_matters: 8个可离子化药物在DOPC上的logKlipw：中性物种约4.5到2.4，离子化物种约2.6到0.8。证明离子态分配显著且受静电作用影响，不能按经典pH分配理论当成零

title: Derivative spectrophotometry as a tool for the determination of drug partition coefficients in water/DMPG liposomes
why_matters: 膜电荷对分配的影响：中性药物在阴离子DMPG与两性离子DMPC中Kp相近，离子化药物差异大（阳离子地布卡因偏好DMPG，阴离子利福平偏好DMPC）。膜组成决定分配的早期直接证据，服务E工作流

title: Lipophilicity Modulations by Fluorination Correlate with Membrane Partitioning
why_matters: logP适用边界的正面证据：对给定化合物类别，logPow与膜摩尔分配系数logKp有极好相关性。用19F固体NMR MAS配脂质囊泡测定。与Duncan 2020合起来界定logP的可用范围

title: Do Liposome-binding Constants of Porphyrins Correlate with Their Measured and Predicted Partitioning Between Octanol and Water
why_matters: 17个卟啉加2个二氢卟吩：整体集合上logP与logD和脂质体结合常数相关性不佳，但结构相似的子序列内部线性关系良好。同系物内可用跨类别不可用的直接证据

title: Accessing lipophilicity of drugs with biomimetic models: A comparative study using liposomes and micelles
why_matters: 用OECD指南参考物质对比：仿生模型的分配系数彼此差别大但都比辛醇水更可靠；胶束只适用于logKp>3；总体脂质体最佳；含COSMOmic对比并给出工具选择决策树

title: How can we better realize the potential of immobilized artificial membrane chromatography in drug discovery and development
why_matters: 罕见的诚实表述：辛醇水体系被批评为肤浅和过度简化，但直接用脂质体也受限于制备标准化稳定性困难以及分配实验本身重复性有限。与A工作流测量端噪声结论一致

title: Immobilised artificial membrane liquid chromatography vs liposome electrokinetic capillary chromatography in drug/bio membrane partitioning studies
why_matters: 26个结构无关类药分子：IAM与多数LEKC参数对中性态logPo/w只中等线性相关，对logD7.4更弱且部分呈S形；LEKC与实测肺渗透性相关R2>0.65优于IAM。LEKC不适用于高亲水中性或阴离子化合物

title: Determination of lipid-water partition coefficient of neutral and ionic drugs by liposome electrokinetic chromatography
why_matters: LEKC测logKL/W；线性自由能关系分析指出溶质体积、氢键碱性、J-是驱动分配的主要描述符；DSPC/Chol比SPC/Chol更适合模拟细胞膜（与Caco-2相关R2分别0.81和0.72）

title: A novel device for the determination of liposome/water partition coefficients
why_matters: 自制廉价平衡透析装置测logPl/w，HPLC-UV/GC-MS/DPV三法结果可比；发现NaCl影响很大：4-羟基苄醇在0.15M NaCl下logPl/w为1.06，无盐时2.06。低成本自测分配系数的可行方案

title: Determination of liposome partitioning of ionizable drugs by titration
why_matters: 快速pH-metric滴定法测可离子化药物的脂质体分配，支持高脂药比，结果与其他技术和大单层囊泡一致。适合做高通量筛选的分配测定

title: Alternative measures of lipophilicity: from octanol-water partitioning to IAM retention
why_matters: 亲脂性参数的系统综述，专节讨论脂质体水分配的困难以及磷脂亲脂性与传统亲脂性概念的差别。写方法学论证时的背景引用

title: Descriptor-Guided Selection of Extracellular Vesicle Loading Strategies for Small-Molecule Drug Delivery
why_matters: 方法学上可能救项目的一篇：连续回归LOOCV R2只有0.06到0.41，但把目标改成在候选载药方法里排序后，决策级准确率内部76.5%、外部75%、重复随机80.5±16.8%。绝对值预测不达标时的产品化出路

title: Comparative Analysis of Chemical Descriptors by Machine Learning Reveals Atomistic Insights into Solute-Lipid Interactions
why_matters: 与本仓库现行做法直接冲突：182个药物在中链甘油三酯中的溶解度，SOAP描述符在精度和可解释性上最优（测试集RMSE 0.50），ECFP4指纹明显最差。含不确定度估计界定适用域。消融1的直接依据

title: Predicting zeta potential of liposomes from their structure: A nano-QSPR model for DOPE, DC-Chol, DOTAP, and EPC formulations
why_matters: 给出本仓库缺的多组分混合规则：按组分脂质摩尔分数计算分子纳米描述符的公式；R2=0.96、Q2loo=0.83、外部Q2=0.89；关键结构特征是HLB和生成焓

title: Towards better modelling of drug-loading in solid lipid nanoparticles: Molecular dynamics, docking experiments and Gaussian Processes machine learning
journal: European Journal of Pharmaceutics and Biopharmaceutics
why_matters: 物理与数据驱动的混合范式：GROMACS模拟三棕榈酸甘油酯基质后用MOE对接拿结合能，再用高斯过程把MW/xLogP/TPSA/fragment complexity映射到结合能。摘要只说偏差低于以往研究，需全文取数值

title: Poly(DL-lactide-co-glycolic acid) nanoparticle design and payload prediction: a molecular descriptor based study
why_matters: 三套描述符平台对比（DRAGON R2=0.889/Q2=0.657/R2pred=0.616，MOE与VolSurf+略低）；药效团空间建模指出氢键受体和芳环特征对载药起主要作用

title: Quantitative Self-Assembly Prediction Yields Targeted Nanomedicines
why_matters: QSNAP模型：电拓扑描述符高度预测纳米自组装与粒径，载药量最高达90%。电拓扑这一类描述符本仓库未用过，值得进消融

title: Characterization of Lipid Nanoparticles Containing Ionizable Cationic Lipids Using Design-of-Experiments Approach
why_matters: 两条关键结论：可离子化脂质在电荷中和时相分离形成核心的无定形油滴；制备参数（脂质浓度/FRR/TFR）对siRNA包封率无影响但脂质浓度和FRR显著影响粒径与PDI。后者可直接用来拆分EE模型与粒径模型的特征集

title: Unravelling the interactions between small molecules and liposomal bilayers via molecular dynamics and thermodynamic modelling
why_matters: 最好的机理案例研究：萘普生停在水磷脂界面且渗透自由能屏障低，非洛地平钻进疏水尾区且屏障高；用Flory-Huggins建模加SAXS/DLS/TEM/释放交叉确认；下游后果成链（互溶性、粒径、释放速率）。可作载入位置分档的标注范例

title: Structuring of lipid nanoparticle mRNA formulations at acidic and neutral pH: X-ray scattering and molecular dynamics studies
why_matters: LNP含水量低于1% w/w；pH 4时水相界面形成双层而核心基本无定形，pH 7.4时整体无定形；RNA位于水簇与脂质界面。制备pH与成品pH是两套不同环境，特征须分pH记录

title: Molecular Insight into Lipid Nanoparticle Assembly from NMR Spectroscopy and Molecular Dynamics Simulation
why_matters: 与主流认知冲突：阳离子与可离子化脂质通常被认为位于核心，本文发现它们与PEG脂质相互作用并共存于粒子外层。这个不确定性意味着特征构造不要把机理假设写死

title: Structure of Lipid Nanoparticles Containing siRNA or mRNA by Dynamic Nuclear Polarization-Enhanced NMR Spectroscopy
why_matters: 层状结构模型：DSPC与DMPE-PEG2000富集表面层，胆固醇与可离子化阳离子脂质嵌在核心，核心均质。与Li 2025结论相反，两篇需并列引用

title: Molecular Dynamics of Lipid Nanoparticles Explored through Solution and Solid-State NMR Spectroscopy and MD Simulations
why_matters: 支持siRNA载药LNP的致密核心模型：阳离子脂质在纳秒尺度动力学最高且被siRNA包载降低迁移率，DSPC与胆固醇构成运动较慢的外膜；给出-50到30度的相变温度节点

title: Small-angle X-ray scattering unveils the internal structure of lipid nanoparticles
journal: Journal of Colloid and Interface Science
why_matters: 挑战经典核壳模型：同步辐射SAXS显示SLN为桶状形貌、由共面脂质小板堆叠构成、表面覆盖松散聚山梨酯80且极性头保留大量结合水。内部结构模型直接影响载药位置假设

title: On the Structure of Solid Lipid Nanoparticles
why_matters: SLN有结晶脂质核心，储存时多晶型转变导致药物提前释放；小角中子散射加全原子MD揭示表面活性剂稳定结晶核心的分子机制

title: Dependence of the Core-Shell Structure on the Lipid Composition of Nanostructured Lipid Carriers
why_matters: NLC为刚性壳加较软核心；给出可量化关系：固体脂质占总脂质比例与各向异性差r_gap、转变焓、结晶度百分比呈线性相关。SLN/NLC体系的必记元数据依据

title: A Coarse-Grained Molecular Dynamics Perspective on the Release of 5-Fluorouracil from Liposomes
why_matters: MD与实验不符的诚实案例：MD预测胆固醇会减慢5-FU释放，体外实验显示释放动力学不受胆固醇影响而10 mol% DOTAP给出最佳曲线。证明MD预测不能直接当实验替代，引用MD结果时必须一起写

title: Vesicle-like structure of lipid-based nanoparticles as drug delivery system revealed by molecular dynamics simulations
why_matters: SLN/纳米乳/NLC三者在平衡态都呈囊泡样结构，亲水头基折成半双层伸进内部，内有被头基包围的包陷水腔；三者都未结晶；NLC脂质分布对固液脂质质量比不敏感

title: Understanding the molecular insights of marketed liposomal drugs using molecular dynamics simulations of reduced scale coarse-grained models
why_matters: 九个上市脂质体药物的CG-MD（Doxil/Onivyde/Ambisome等）：药物质子化显著降低与磷脂膜的结合但不改变取向（疏水朝内亲水朝外）；主动载药体系中囊腔内离子促进药物自聚集提高保留

title: Ionizable lipids penetrate phospholipid bilayers with high phase transition temperatures: perspectives from free energy calculations
why_matters: 自由能计算：DLin-MC3-DMA偏好饱和DMPC而排斥不饱和DOPE/DOPC且与相变温度相关；ALC-0315结合最强，MC3无法停留在双层中心。并为SM-102和ALC-0315推导了力场参数

title: Ionizable Amino Lipids Distribution and Effects on DSPC/Cholesterol Membranes: Implications for Lipid Nanoparticle Structure
why_matters: 全原子MD，Moderna的Lipid-5（表观pKa 6.56）：高可离子化脂质浓度下中性胺脂在膜内部形成无序聚集体并优先把胆固醇纳入其中。解释了核心作为溶剂环境的本质

title: pH-dependent structural transitions in cationic ionizable lipid mesophases are critical for lipid nanoparticle function
why_matters: 随pH降低出现有序介晶相序列（各向同性反胶束到立方Fd3m到反六角到双连续立方Pn3m）；小鼠肝表达MC3>=KC2>DD而各细胞组分mRNA递送量相似；pH 6处Fd3m到反六角转变是区分标志

title: Formulation and Characterization of Novel Ionizable and Cationic Lipid Nanoparticles for the Delivery of Splice-Switching Oligonucleotides
why_matters: 与通常说法相反：SAXS指导设计发现反胶束相组织的LNP表现最好（超过Onpattro组成），而具有反六角相的LNP不起作用，提示反六角相可能并非递送所必需

title: Spatial Conformation of Ionizable Lipids Regulates Endosomal Membrane Disruption
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
why_matters: pKa不足以解释性能：18个可生物还原可离子化脂质（2到4条尾链），三尾脂质在pKa相近时内体破坏与胞内递送明显更优，因其锥形构象；尾链分支过多并不线性改善

title: Iterative Design of Ionizable Lipids for Intramuscular mRNA Delivery
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
why_matters: 乙醇胺核心加LNP表观pKa 6.6到6.9最大化肌注mRNA递送；并报告脂质对mRNA质量比与蛋白表达呈非线性关系，存在临界质量比。氢键、离子化行为、质量比是三个关键设计参数

title: Prediction of Phospholipid-Water Partition Coefficients of Ionic Organic Chemicals Using the Mechanistic Model COSMOmic
why_matters: 机理模型精度基准：161个中性加75个离子化合物，COSMOmic中性RMSE 0.62、离子化0.70个对数单位，是首个对两类物种都优于1个对数单位的机理模型。支持把计算Klipw当特征而非让模型自己学分配

title: Development And Test of Highly Accurate Endpoint Free Energy Methods 2: Prediction of logP for druglike molecules using MM-PBSA
why_matters: 707个ZINC分子，MM-PBSA自由能法RMSE 0.91对数单位、R=0.71，优于常用QSPR与ML模型（次优OpenBabel 1.13/0.67），且未对实验logP做参数拟合。物理法优于数据驱动的直接证据

title: Expanded ensemble predictions of toluene-water partition coefficients in the SAMPL9 LogP challenge
why_matters: 真正的盲测：SAMPL9挑战16个类药分子，扩展集合自由能法RMSD 2.26 kcal/mol即1.65 logP单位、R2=0.80。盲测精度明显差于非盲预测，这个落差本身是A工作流的素材

title: Molecular dynamics trajectories for 630 coarse-grained drug-membrane permeations
license_status: 未核实（Scientific Data常为CC BY，待核实）
why_matters: 现成可用的公开MD数据集：630条粗粒化药物膜渗透轨迹共15120次模拟，穷举105个粗粒化二聚体对6种磷脂，伞形采样给出完整平均力势。C工作流高价值目标，且不用自己跑MD

title: Martini 3 Building Blocks for Lipid Nanoparticle Design
journal: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
why_matters: Martini 3脂质库大幅扩展：新增一百多个可离子化脂质模型加天然固醇加PEG化脂质，并给出筛选融合效能和构建完整LNP的协议。自己跑LNP模拟的现成工具链

title: Computational Methods for Modeling Lipid-Mediated Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Delivery
why_matters: B6的入口综述：同时覆盖物理方法（全原子与粗粒化MD）和数据驱动方法，讨论两者兼容性以及获得可靠模拟结果的必要条件。写方法学论证从这篇开始

title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations of Liposomes: Structure, Dynamics, and Applications
why_matters: 脂质体MD综述：列出膜生物物理量（每脂面积APL、双层厚度、序参数SCD、径向分布、弯曲模量、flip-flop）以及各力场（MARTINI/SPICA/SIRAH/ELBA/SDK）的优劣，含建模工具TS2CG与CHARMM-GUI Martini Maker

title: Molecular Drivers of Self-Assembly in RNA-Loaded lipid nanoparticles Revealed by Coarse-Grained simulations
why_matters: 粗粒化MD解释乙醇含量效应：乙醇增加时PEG脂质向内迁移，外表面PEG减少导致调控聚集能力下降从而粒径变大，且颗粒更大更无序。与实验观察的高乙醇产大颗粒一致

title: Coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulation of gallic acid delivery using span60-based niosomes
why_matters: 少见的小分子多酚（没食子酸）在niosome中的CG-MD：给出囊内分布以及从核心穿过双层的平均力势曲线。与圣草酚同属多酚类，是本批最接近的分子类比

title: Development of a concentration-controlled sequential nanoprecipitation for making lipid nanoparticles with high drug loading
why_matters: 浓度控制顺序纳米沉淀法实现可调载药量最高70 wt%，适用于从极疏水到微亲水的广谱药物。难溶小分子高载药的工艺参考

title: Navigating the challenges of lipid nanoparticle formulation: the role of unpegylated lipid surfactants in enhancing drug loading and stability
why_matters: 非PEG化与PEG化表面活性剂共混可把载药量推过10%；Lipoid S100有成核作用；药物与核心材料共混会破坏核心结晶性从而影响释放与稳定性

title: Solid lipid nanoparticles and nanostructured lipid carriers: A review emphasizing on particle structure and drug release
journal: European Journal of Pharmaceutics and Biopharmaceutics
why_matters: 明确指出该领域对颗粒结构没有共识，且很少有研究同时关注药物在颗粒中的优先位置与脂质/稳定剂的排布；提出基于固体脂质多晶型的结构模型

title: Analytical characterization of liposomes and other lipid nanoparticles for drug delivery
journal: Journal of Pharmaceutical and Biomedical Analysis
why_matters: 脂质纳米粒表征方法的系统梳理，含脂质种类、包封率、颗粒特性、稳定性、释放等CQA的可用分析手段对比。定自己表征SOP时的方法清单来源

title: Lipid Nanoparticle Database towards structure-function modeling and data-driven design for nucleic acid delivery
license_status: Nat Commun为CC BY，站点条款待核实
why_matters: 单一来源规模最大的LNP数据：19528个LNP，比现用LNP Atlas大18倍；标准化特征编码，自动生成CHARMM力场文件，支持社区贡献。网址lnpdb.molcube.com。待核实小分子载荷占比

title: Smart Microfluidics: A curated dataset of microfluidic liposome formulations with cross-laboratory validation for machine-learning applications
license_status: Data in Brief通常CC BY，待核实
why_matters: 同时填上A工作流空白：304个微混合器脂质体配方加12个独立湿实验室验证配方，来自两个独立实验室，原文明确说跨实验室记录可评估操作者变异与设备重复性。数据在Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17867478，含清洗脚本与元数据字典

title: Making in vitro release and formulation data AI-ready: A foundation for streamlined nanomedicine development
license_status: Int J Pharm X开放获取，待核实
why_matters: 开放获取脂质体配方加体外释放数据库，并基于条目评估提出一套数据标准和数据库结构。原文直接说药剂学领域缺少整理好的开放数据库而纳米药物尤其如此，可引用在申请材料

title: A formulation dataset of poly(lactide-co-glycolide) nanoparticles for small molecule delivery
why_matters: 433个PLGA配方覆盖65个小分子，小分子多样性可能超过本项目现有272条的小分子子集。载体非脂质，可作迁移学习源或检验分子描述符关系是否跨载体成立

title: Unleashing the Power of Machine Learning in Nanomedicine Formulation Development
why_matters: 结构最适合本项目的自产数据集：约200个配方超550次测量，脂质体/LNP/PLGA三类载体，空载或载姜黄素，同时测直径PDI和包封率；13个ML模型对比并与ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek对照

title: Simple Scattering: Lipid nanoparticle structural data repository
why_matters: 唯一的公开LNP内部结构散射数据仓储（SAXS与SANS成组相关谱），强调标准化元数据描述配方参数。若要把结构相作为中间变量进模型这是唯一公开数据源

title: MDverse, shedding light on the dark matter of molecular dynamics simulations
why_matters: 覆盖仓储的正确工具：用原创检索策略在Zenodo/Figshare/OSF索引出约25万个文件和2000个数据集并做了检索引擎原型。说明Consensus不索引仓储条目，普查仓储应用此类元资源加站内API

title: Synthetic dataset of PLGA and liposome nanocarrier formulations for brain-cancer-relevant drug delivery
why_matters: 警示条目：6000个虚拟配方约84.6万行，字段齐全含EE和载药量，但作者明确声明是完全合成数据不复现任何已发表实验行。绝不可用于训练生产模型，仅可做流水线压力测试

title: Meta-Analysis and Machine Learning Prediction of Protein Corona Composition across Nanoparticle Systems in Biological Media
why_matters: 蛋白冠数据库PC-DB：83项研究817个NP配方2497种吸附蛋白，粒径1到1400nm、Zeta -70到+70mV；脂质基NP占14.8%；LightGBM/XGBoost ROC-AUC>0.85，粒径Zeta孵育时间是最重要预测因子。服务E工作流

title: Designing Optimum Drug Delivery Systems Using Machine Learning Approaches: a Prototype Study of Niosomes
why_matters: 按PRISMA筛选出114个niosome配方，11个输入属性，ANN对药物包封率和粒径预测准确率93.76%和91.79%；用9个多奈哌齐批次验证达97%以上；敏感性分析指出药脂比与胆固醇表面活性剂比最关键

title: Effect of drug molecular weight on niosomes size and encapsulation efficiency
why_matters: 分子量对niosome粒径与EE的影响，且囊泡越大EE越高（纯物理的装载体积效应）；重要方法学警告：用粘性溶液时凝胶过滤不是合适的纯化方法，会使EE测量失真

title: Revisiting the lipid ratio in lipid nanoparticles: A comparison of OFAT and design of experiments approaches
why_matters: 多个非标准摩尔比也能达到粒径<120nm、PDI<0.2、EE>75%，说明传统脂质比稳健但不一定最优；DoE揭示组成与CQA的非线性且过程依赖关系，在所探索设计空间内预测能力有限（尤其生物学输出）；手工对自动微流控制备结果有差异

title: Optimization of Solid Lipid Nanoparticle Formulation Using Design of Experiments PART I
why_matters: 空白SLN的混合设计（三种蜡的混合变量加两个定量因素），优化结果粒径176.3±2.78nm、PDI 0.268±0.022、Zeta -35.5±0.36mV。辅料为蜡类混合物，SMILES不可解析

title: Formulation development of lipid nanoparticles: improved lipid screening and development of tacrolimus loaded nanostructured lipid carriers
why_matters: 用Hansen溶解度参数替代传统脂质筛选，两法结果相似但实验量大减，EE约99%；表面活性剂规律：高HLB、低分子量、短烷基链倾向形成更小更窄更稳定的粒子。脂质筛选的理论化路线

title: Encapsulation of flavonoids in liposomal delivery systems: the case of quercetin, kaempferol and luteolin
why_matters: 本批最接近圣草酚的一篇（木犀草素是黄酮，圣草酚是对应二氢黄酮）：黄酮进入脂质体膜的程度强烈依赖结构与载药浓度；槲皮素与木犀草素粒径小保留好、山柰酚差；拉曼与红外显示黄酮调制脂链动力学与堆积序

title: Influence of different production processes on the formation of asolectin-based colloids to improve quercetin and rutin formulation efficiency
why_matters: 同系物对照证明最优制备方法随分子变化：槲皮素最优为薄膜水化（EE>90%，水溶性升10倍），芦丁最优为微流控（载药量约12%不沉淀）。含义是制备方法必须作为模型输入特征且与分子存在交互项

title: Topical formulation of quercetin encapsulated in natural lipid nanocarriers: Evaluation of biological properties and phototoxic effect
journal: Journal of Drug Delivery Science and Technology
why_matters: 与首发管线（皮肤递送）最直接相关：天然脂质NLC载槲皮素，粒径130nm、EE 97.42%；关键机理是低重结晶指数13.03%带来高包封并避免储存期析出；重建人皮肤模型无光毒性，粒径PDI 120天稳定

title: Nanostructured lipid carrier-embedded hydrogels for enhanced skin delivery of quercetin: Optimized formulation with pomegranate oil for UVB protection
why_matters: 皮肤递送方向的直接参照：Box-Behnken优化NLC，EE 55%优于SLN的43%，粒径200到300nm，胶体稳定3个月，人角质细胞抗UVB光保护。诚实负面结果：包封后槲皮素抗氧化活性略有下降

title: Evaluation of antioxidant efficacy of quercetin encapsulated in micelles, mixed micelles, or liposomes in oil-in-water emulsions
why_matters: 对抗氧化剂递送产品的红线警告：短期实验脂质体形式抗氧化保护最强（与油相生育酚协同），但长期实验中脂质体内槲皮素发生化学降解，限制长期有效性。包封提高递送但可能缩短活性成分化学寿命

title: Development of new liposomal formulations of quercetin - in vitro study
why_matters: 少见的主动载药思路：把疏水槲皮素与铜离子络合后载入脂质体水相而非嵌在膜里；对A-375和C32黑色素瘤细胞有毒而对正常人角质细胞HaCaT无毒。对应B5的内部水腔位置

title: Design and advanced characterization of quercetin-loaded nano-liposomes prepared by high-pressure homogenization
why_matters: 槲皮素EE跨度区间的下端（42%）：高压均质150MPa一次为最优条件；用多检测器AF4加分析超离加TEM表征，强调单一技术不足以表征纳米级多分散样品

title: Optimization of Preparation Conditions for Quercetin Nanoliposomes Using Response Surface Methodology and Evaluation of Their Stability
license_status: ACS Omega为开放获取，待核实

title: Development and optimization of stealth liposomal system for enhanced in vitro cytotoxic effect of quercetin
journal: Journal of Drug Delivery Science and Technology

title: A comparative study of liposomes and chitosomes for topical quercetin antioxidant therapy
journal: Journal of Drug Delivery Science and Technology
why_matters: 局部给药对比：脂质体对壳聚糖脂质体，粒径184到342.7nm、EE均>78%，评价了皮肤蓄积；壳聚糖脂质体因协同作用抗氧化更强。皮肤方向的对照组设计参考

title: Development of Liposomal and Liquid Crystalline Lipidic Nanoparticles with Non-Ionic Surfactants for Quercetin Incorporation

title: Enhanced bioactivity and efficient delivery of quercetin through nanoliposomal encapsulation using rice bran phospholipids
journal: Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture

title: Encapsulation of the flavonoid quercetin with chitosan-coated nano-liposomes

why_matters: SLN与NLC的直接对比综述：NLC用固液脂质混合基质可载更多药、改善释放、提高稳定性。本项目若转NLC方向的背景引用
